args.purpose: Calculate revenue, order count, and average review score for South region vs Overall marketplace
args.sql:
WITH order_base AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_state,
        CASE WHEN c.customer_state IN ('PR', 'SC', 'RS') THEN 'South' ELSE 'Other/Total' END as region_type,
        CASE WHEN o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_valid_sale
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
item_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ob.order_id,
        ob.customer_state,
        ob.region_type,
        ob.is_valid_sale,
        SUM(oi.price) as order_revenue
    FROM order_base ob
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON ob.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
review_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ob.order_id,
        ob.region_type,
        r.review_score
    FROM order_base ob
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON ob.order_id = r.order_id
)
SELECT 
    'South' as region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_sale = 1 THEN order_id END) as order_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_sale = 1 THEN order_revenue ELSE 0 END) as revenue,
    AVG(r.review_score) as avg_review_score
FROM item_stats i
LEFT JOIN review_stats r ON i.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE i.region_type = 'South'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Overall' as region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_valid_sale = 1 THEN order_id END) as order_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_sale = 1 THEN order_revenue ELSE 0 END) as revenue,
    AVG(r.review_score) as avg_review_score
FROM item_stats i
LEFT JOIN review_stats r ON i.order_id = r.order_id

    count(DISTINCT o.order_id)::VARCHAR as order_count,
    sum(oi.price)::VARCHAR as revenue,
    round(avg(r.review_score), 2)::VARCHAR as avg_review
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

GROUP BY c.customer_state

q10.sql:
WITH state_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN o.order_id END) as order_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) as revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE c.customer_state IN ('PR', 'SC', 'RS')
    GROUP BY c.customer_state
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(revenue) as south_revenue
    FROM state_summary
),
marketplace AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
)
SELECT 
    s.customer_state,
    s.order_count,
    ROUND(s.revenue, 2) as revenue_exact,
    ROUND(s.revenue / 1000.0, 1) as revenue_k,
    ROUND((SELECT south_revenue FROM totals) / (SELECT total_revenue FROM marketplace) * 100, 1) as south_pct
FROM state_summary s
ORDER BY s.revenue DESC
